pardon_our_dust_modal_body:
TFT has just gotten a tech update, and we're now on a new engine! No action is needed on your end; your Riot ID, RP, and Friends List are still shared across League of Legends, and your TFT collection is coming with you. Some of your existing cosmetics may not be available right away, but they'll all be added across future patches along with our regular balance updates and bugfixes. Because we've rebuilt TFT on a new engine, you may notice some differences in models, textures, VFX, or animations in-game or across your Tacticians and Arenas.

For more detailed information and support, please visit {{link}}.
